title: myriopus suffruticosus
intro: Myriopus suffruticosus, commonly known as Bluebells, is a type of flowering plant in the borage family, Boraginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of Myriopus suffruticosus include pain relief, reduction of inflammation, and relaxation of muscles. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
